source: 667 Approaching Gentleness
target: 667 Mansuetudinem Accedens

source: Camus’s nerves tensed as he propped himself up on his left hand, surveying his surroundings warily.
target: Nervi Camusi contracti sunt dum manu sinistra se sustentans circumiecta caute intuēbatur.

source: He realized he was still on the second floor of Twanaku’s house.
target: Animadvertit se adhuc in secundo tabulato domus Twanaku esse.

source: Rhea, who had been leaning against a wooden pillar, stood up in a daze.
target: Rhea, quae in columna lignea recubuerat, stupefacta surrexit.

source: Everything around him seemed no different from before he had fallen asleep.
target: Omnia circa eum eadem videbantur, sicut antequam obdormiret.

source: “Are you joking?” Camus asked Louis Berry cautiously.
target: «Iocarisne?» inquit Camus ad Ludovicum Berry caute.

source: What kind of Dream Festival is this?
target: Quale est hoc Festum Somniorum?

source: This feels like a normal awakening after a nap!
target: Hoc instat ut experrectus ordinarius post somnum brevem!

source: Lumian turned and pointed out the window.
target: Lumian conversus est et ad fenestram demonstravit.

source: “Listen to the forest sounds.”
target: «Audi sonos silvae.»

source: Camus and Rhea instinctively listened, realizing that the nearby forest was eerily silent, as if all its inhabitants had fallen asleep in the night.
target: Camus et Rhea instanter audiverunt, animadvertentes silvam proximam insolenter silentem esse, quasi omnes incolae eius noctu obdormiti essent.

source: Wh— Rhea’s eyes narrowed.
target: Heu— oculi Rhea contracti sunt.

source: Born and raised in the primitive forest and having lived in Tizamo Town for nearly a year, she knew the forest wouldn’t be in such absolute silence.
target: Nata et educata in silva primitiva, ac paene annum in oppido Tizamo vixisse, scivit silvam non tam absolute silentem fore.

source: Lumian pointed at the floor beside the mosquito repellent candle.
target: Lumian ad solum iuxta candela repellens culices demonstravit.

source: “Look here again.”
target: «Rursus hic intuere.»

source: Camus and Rhea looked over, realizing that the mosquito corpses that should have been there were gone.
target: Camus et Rhea intuerebantur, animadvertentes corpora culicum, quae illic esse debuerant, evanuisse.

source: Lumian chuckled.
target: Lumian risit.

source: “Of course, you can also believe that I woke up early, cleaned up the environment, and secretly affected your hearing of distant voices. All of this was just a prank.”
target: «Scilicet, et credere potestis me mane experrectum esse, ambitum purgatum, et clam vestram auditionem vocum remotarum mutavisse. Haec omnia nihil aliud quam iocus erant.»

source: Camus pondered for a few seconds.
target: Camus paucos momenta meditatus est.

source: “I’m inclined to believe you, but I need to confirm something.”
target: «Inclino ut te credam, sed aliquid confirmare debeo.»

source: “Indeed,” Rhea chimed in, carrying a hunting bow and arrows.
target: «Certe,» inquit Rhea, ferens arcum venatorium et sagittas.

source: Lumian looked at them and nodded slightly.
target: Lumian ad eos respexit et leviter annuit.

source: He calmly concluded, I can now determine that the reason I remain conscious in this peculiar dream stems from a hidden power within Hisoka’s house, not any special traits of my own.
target: Quiete conclusit: nunc determinare possum causam cur in hoc somnio singulari conscius maneam, ex occultā potentiā in domo Hisoka provenire, non ex aliquibus meis singularibus proprietatibus.

source: He had invited Camus and Rhea to slumber in Hisoka’s house and enter the special dream not merely to share information with the patrol team and gather a few aides.
target: Camus et Rhea invitaverat ut in domo Hisoka obdormirent atque in somnium speciale intrarent, non tantum ad informationem cum manipulo vigilum communicandam et aliquos adiutores colligendos.

source: No, it was also an experiment to uncover key details!
target: Minime, experimentum etiam erat ad detegenda elementa clavis!

source: Over the past few days, Lumian had conducted numerous similar trials, grasping the dream’s nuanced patterns like a seasoned explorer mapping uncharted lands.
target: Per dies praeteritos, Lumian multa experimenta similia egit, subtilia somnii ordines, sicut peritus explorator terras ignotas delineans, comprehensus.

source: With hands tucked nonchalantly in his pockets, he trailed behind Camus and Rhea, who hurried downstairs.
target: Manibus noncuranter in sinu reclusis, post Camum et Raeam se trahebat, quae celeriter deorsum gradus descenderunt.

source: He wanted to witness how they would confirm whether this was indeed a dream.
target: Volebat videre quomodo comprobarent an hoc vere somnium esset.

source: After departing Twanaku’s house, the two patrol members rushed to the nearest townsperson’s abode.
target: Postquam domum Twanaku reliquerunt, duo vigilum membra ad domicilium civis proximæ festinaverunt.

source: Upon realizing the livestock had vanished from the ground floor, Rhea swiftly ascended to the second story and attempted to unlock the door with a simple iron-black key.
target: Animadverte pecora a primo tabulato evanuisse, Rhea celeriter in secundum tabulatum ascendit et conata est ostium clāvis ferreae nigrae simplicis aperire.

source: Camus opened his mouth as if to dissuade her, but in the end, remained silent.
target: Camus os aperuit quasi eam detrectare velle, sed denique tacitus remansit.

source: Observing this, Lumian nodded thoughtfully and muttered to himself, A Beyonder of the Arbiter pathway will subconsciously maintain the current order, unwilling to disrupt its fabric. If such Beyonders also bear official identities, this tendency only intensifies…
target: Observans hoc, Lumian cogitans annuit et sibi ipsi murmuravit: "Beyonder viae Arbiteris subconscie ordinem praesentem servabit, nolens eius structuram perturbare. Si tales Beyonder etiam identitates officiales ferant, haec inclinatio solum augebitur…"

source: Rhea rapped upon the door and entered the dwelling.
target: Rhea ostium percussit et in domicilium intravit.

source: She and Camus scoured each room, but the resident family had seemingly evaporated into thin air.
target: Ea et Camus quolibet conclave perquisiverunt, sed familia incola quasi in aerem tenuem evanuerat.

source: Then, the pair made their way to the police station near the Saint-Sien Cathedral’s hallowed grounds.
target: Deinde, par iter fecit ad stationem vigilum iuxta spatia sacra Cathedrali Sancti-Sien.

source: The local patrol quarters held five rooms in total.
target: Praesidia locales vigilium quinque conclavia habebant in summa.

source: Kolobo, Maslow, and Loban were nowhere to be found, nor were the two officers meant to stand the night watch.
target: Kolobo, Maslow, et Loban nusquam reperti sunt, nec duo officiales, qui nocturnam vigiliam tenere debuerunt, apparuerunt.

source: “I now believe this is a dream,” Camus declared to Louis Berry, who leisurely trailed with hands tucked in pockets, a golden straw hat shading his features.
target: «Nunc credo hoc esse somnium,» proclamavit Camus ad Ludovicum Berry, qui tarde se sequebatur, manibus in sinu reclusis, galea aurea ex stragulis vultum suum tegens.

source: “Yet I’m so utterly awake that it defies the very notion of a dream.”
target: «Sed tam plane vigilans sum ut ipsa notio somnii repugnet.»

source: Before Lumian could respond, Rhea’s light-brown face furrowed slightly.
target: Antequam Lumian responderet, facies Rhea, colore castaneo claro, leviter contraxit.

source: “When I ran down the street and searched these rooms, it felt a little… familiar.”
target: «Cum per viam cucurri et haec cubicula perquisivi, aliquid… familiare mihi apparuit.»

source: “Familiar?” Lumian asked calmly, his brows unfurrowed.
target: «Familiare?» inquit Lumian tranquille, superciliis non contractis.

source: Could there be unexpected gains from this experiment?
target: Num ex hoc experimento beneficia inopinata oriuntur?

source: Rhea pondered for a moment.
target: Rhea paulisper meditata est.

source: “I think I’ve had a similar dream before.”
target: «Puto me simile somnium antea habuisse.»

source: “In my dream, it was just as dark and quiet. The streets were empty, and I was alone. I ran around, searching…”
target: «In somnio meo, totum aeque obscurum ac quietum erat. Viae vacuae erant, et solus eram. Circumcurreram, quaerens…»

source: “Was it a mere fragment or a complete dream?” Lumian pressed.
target: «Fuitne id solum fragmentum an integrum somnium?» instanter quaesivit Lumian.

source: Rhea thought for a few seconds.
target: Rhea paucos momenta meditata est.

source: “I don’t know. I only remember a few such scenes.”
target: «Nescio. Tantum paucas huiusmodi scenae memini.»

source: “Do you often dream of this, or only occasionally?” Lumian guided her to confirm the details.
target: «Saepene hoc somnium tibi occurrit, an tantum interdum?» Lumian eam interrogavit ad singula confirmanda.

source: Rhea replied with certainty, “Occasionally.”
target: Rhea certo respondit: «Interdum.»

source: “Occasionally…”
target: «Interdum…»

source: Even if the Tizamo residents don’t slumber here on a specific date, they can occasionally enter this peculiar dream, yet remain unable to stay awake.
target: Etiamsi incolae Tizamo hic in certo die non obdormiant, interdum hoc somnium singulare intrare possunt, sed vigilare perseverare non possunt.

source: Like a normal dream?
target: Velut somnium normale?

source: Perhaps it’s not true immersion, but rather an unconscious development spiritually spawned from the crimson moon and other environmental elements, allowing them to vaguely interact.
target: Forsitan non vera immersio sit, sed potius inconscius progressus spiritualis ex rubra luna et aliis elementis ambientis, qui eos ad vago modum interagi sinit.

source: Unfortunately, Rhea clearly doesn’t recall the moon, weather, and other situational details from those dreams.
target: Infeliciter, Rhea manifeste non meminit lunam, tempestatem, atque cetera singula ex illis somniis.

source: If I could employ Dream Divination, I could aid her recollection…
target: Si somnii divinationem adhibere possem, eius memoriam adiuvare possem…

source: The few Tizamons I queried in Port Pylos made no mention of such dreams.
target: Pauci Tizamonenses, quos in Portu Pylos interrogavi, de talibus somniis nihil dixerunt.

source: Firstly, dreams so ordinary often slip the mind.
target: Primum, somnia tam ordinaria saepe ex mente evanescunt.

source: Secondly, they’ve been away from Tizamo for years…
target: Secundo, per annos a Tizamo absunt…

source: As Lumian’s thoughts raced, he turned to Camus to see if the Interrogator had any queries.
target: Dum cogitationes Lumiani festinanter volitabant, ad Camum se convertit ut videret an Interrogator quaestiones haberet.

source: Camus pondered for a moment before asking Rhea, “What do you think is special about the residents of Tizamo?”
target: Camus paulisper meditatus est, deinde Raeam rogavit: "Quid putas de incolis Tizamo, quod eos speciales faciat?"

source: Very perceptive.
target: Valde perspicax.

source: Since this dream seems to affect the entire town and surrounding area, it’s likely these people will display some abnormality in waking life…
target: Cum hoc somnium totam urbem ac circumstantiam afficere videatur, verisimile est hos homines aliquam abnormitatem in vita vigili ostendere…

source: Lumian nodded inwardly.
target: Lumian interius annuit.

source: Rhea thought for a moment.
target: Rhea paulisper meditata est.

source: “Nothing special. It’s just that they’re very… obedient.”
target: «Nihil speciale. Sola res est quod sunt valde obsequiosi.»

source: At this, Rhea sighed.
target: Ad hoc, Rhea suspiravit.

source: “They’re extremely polite to others. Gentle personalities, stable emotions, very obedient. Even when angered, they quickly calm down. When trouble arises, they tend to let the authorities handle it instead of fighting amongst themselves or causing public disturbances…”
target: «Ergo erga alios valde comitati sunt. Indoles mansuetae, affectus stables, atque maximi obsequiosi. Etiam cum irati sint, celeriter sedantur. Cum difficultas oritur, praeferunt auctoritates agere, potius quam inter se pugnare aut tumultus publicos creare…»

source: These were all situations Lumian had heard Camus mention and seen in the corresponding intel.
target: Haec erant omnia casus quos Lumian a Camus audiverat referendos et in informatione congruenti conspectos.

source: On the surface, nothing seemed amiss.
target: Superficialiter, nihil aberrans videbatur.

source: It was a state of being tamed.
target: Erat status mansuetus.

source: Rhea added, “Their only issue is a lack of enthusiasm.
target: Rhea addidit: "Unicum eorum problema est defectus studii.

source: It’s not that politeness masks an underlying coldness or hatred.
target: Non est quod urbanitas tegat latentem frigiditatem aut odium.

source: They’re simply… unenthusiastic, as if reluctant to openly display emotion.”
target: Simpliciter… ignavi sunt, quasi nolle affectus aperte exprimere.

source: Upon hearing this, Lumian recalled the Tizamons he’d interacted with over the past few days.
target: Hoc audito, Lumian Tizamonenses quos per dies praeteritos convenerat meminisse coepit.

source: Apart from some gentlemen and ladies from the Northern Continent, the others were calm, gentle, and disinclined to argue.
target: Praeter nonnullos viros et mulieres ex Continente Septentrionali, ceteri erant tranquilli, mansueti, et ad contentionem non conati.

source: They always communicated politely.
target: Semper urbaniter loquebantur.

source: Immediately after, he recalled the Tizamons questioned in Port Pylos—fear, worry, ingratiating expressions, vivid emotions.
target: Statim postea meminit Tizamonenses in Portu Pylos interrogatos—timor, sollicitudine, vultus obsequiosis, et affectus vivos.

source: Clearly different from the Tizamo townspeople!
target: Plane a civibus Tizamo differebant!

source: Most of their emotions have been drawn away into the dream?
target: Plurimi eorum affectus in somnium allati sunt?

source: Lumian finally pinpointed an abnormality about the Tizamons.
target: Lumian denique anomaliam de Tizamonibus determinavit.

source: Their issue clearly didn’t stem solely from attacks by the primitive forest tribe!
target: Quaestio eorum manifeste non solum ex impetus tribus silvarum primitivarum orta erat!

source: Upon hearing Lumian’s guess, Camus couldn’t help but hiss.
target: Audito coniecturam Lumiani, Camus sibilum emittere non potuit.

source: “I knew it. The Tizamons feel… strange. Too docile. Even livestock occasionally grow agitated, resists… Could the reason be…”
target: «Sciebam. Tizamonenses sentiuntur… insoliti. Nimis mansueti. Etiam pecora interdum excitari videntur, repugnantur… An causa sit…»

source: Rhea’s heart skipped a beat as she said solemnly, voice laced with fear, “I’ve been here nearly a year, and I feel much gentler…
target: Cor Rhea paulum percussum est, dum sollemniter dixit, voce metu tincta, "Paene annum hic fui, et me multo mansuorem sentio…

source: “My most intense emotions haven’t dissipated. They’re still in my heart, but most of the time, it’s as if I’m… asleep…”
target: Affectus mei intensissimi nondum evanuerunt. Adhuc in corde meo manent, sed plerumque quasi obdormitus sim…"

source: Rhea began analyzing herself.
target: Rhea coepit se examinare.

source: “From the looks of it, everyone in Tizamo will gradually be affected by this peculiar dream.
target: «Ex aspectu, omnes in Tizamo paulatim huic somnio singulari afficiendi erunt.

source: After leaving, they can slowly escape its influence.”
target: Postquam discesserint, lente eius influxum effugere poterunt.»

source: Lumian glanced at Camus.
target: Lumian Camum aspexit.

source: “For outsiders like us, who’ve only been here a few days, there’s no issue for now.”
target: «Externis ut nobis, qui hic paucis diebus tantummodo fuimus, pro tempore nihil est.»

source: “Perhaps we’ll also become unnaturally gentle if we linger too long.”
target: «Forsitan etiam nos nimis insolenter mansueti fiamus, si nimis diu moramur.»

source: Without waiting for Camus’s response, Lumian inquired, “When will reinforcements from the patrol team and Admiral Guard arrive?”
target: Nisi exspectans responsum Camus, Lumian interrogavit: "Quando subsidia ex manipulo vigilium et Custodia Admiralis pervenient?"

source: At the mention of this, Camus’s expression soured.
target: Ad hoc dictum, vultus Camus obnubilatus est.

source: He gritted his teeth and cursed, “Those selfish bastards!”
target: Dentes contraxit et maledixit: "Illi avari impii!"

source: It’s very likely there won’t be much support.
target: Valde verisimile est parvum subsidium fore.

source: “The Admiral Guard said they already have a Beyonder team here and an army.
target: «Custodes Admirales dixerunt iam hunc Beyonder coetum et exercitum habere.

source: Only Captain Reaza expressed backing for the patrol team.
target: Solus Dux Reaza pro manipulo vigilium suffragium expressit.

source: Dammit, those dogsh*t!”
target: Pro damnatione, illi spurci canes!

source: Lumian was taken aback for a moment before bursting into laughter.
target: Lumian paulisper obstupefactus est, deinde in risum erupit.

source: The newly formed organization under the aboriginal admiral was indeed different from the official Northern Continent organizations.
target: Nova constituta organizatio sub admiro aborigino re vera differebat ab officialibus organizatis Continenti Septentrionali.

source: If this were the Eternal Blazing Sun Church or Church of Earth Mother, the official Beyonders would have already devised a plan and dispatched sufficient force to resolve the issue.
target: Si haec esset Ecclesia Aeternae Solis Incendens aut Ecclesia Matris Terrae, Beyonder oficiales iam consilium excogitaverint et copiam satis misissent ad problemate solvendum.

source: They’d be prepared to obliterate Tizamo if anything went awry.
target: Parati fore dicerent Tizamo exstinguere, si quid male accideret.

source: The current situation is Admiral Querarill believes that with me—a famed adventurer backed by the Church of The Fool, here—I’m able to use its power to resolve Tizamo’s troubles.
target: Res praesentis condicionis est: Admiralis Querarill credit, quod mecum—famosus viator ab Ecclesia Stulti sustentatus—hic, eius potentiam ad quaestiones Tizamo solvendas uti possim.

source: Is there a need to send more Beyonder subordinates to aid me?
target: Num necesse sit plures subalternos Beyonder ad me adiuvandum mittere?

source: That’s true. Beyonders aren’t commodities.
target: Id verum est. Beyonder non sunt mercimonia.

source: If too many powerful ones perish, not only will Admiral Querarill feel the strain, but he won’t be able to effectively rule Matani…
target: Si nimis multi potens intereant, non solum Admiralis Querarill laborem sentiet, sed etiam Matani efficaciter regere non poterit…

source: Recruitment alone can’t quickly fill such a gap, and they won’t be quick to trust newcomers.
target: Solum receptio celeriter talem hiatus complere non potest, neque ad novis cito confidunt.

source: Even nurturing the remaining people with the retrieved Beyonder characteristics poses huge problems.
target: Etiam reliquos homines proprietatibus Beyonder receptis alere magnas difficultates attulit.

source: Low-Sequence Beyonders are manageable, but Mid-Sequence advancement carries high failure risk.
target: Beyonder in serie inferiori tractabiles sunt, sed in serie media progressus magnum periculum defectus fert.

source: After all, most here haven’t mastered the acting method…
target: Postremo, plerique hic modum agendi nondum exceperunt…

source: Lumian quickly grasped Admiral Querarill’s mentality.
target: Lumian celeriter mentalitatem Admiralis Querarill apprehendit.

source: He said to the agitated Camus, “Let me show you around this dream realm and provide an introduction.”
target: Dixit ad Camum concitatus: "Sinite me hunc somnium regnum vobis demonstrare et introductionem praebere."

source: “Alright.” Camus took a deep breath.
target: «Recte.» Camus altum spiritum traxit.

source: He and Rhea followed Lumian through the dark, silent, vacant town.
target: Ipse et Rhea Lumian per oppidum obscurum, silentem, et desertum secuti sunt.

source: After a long while, Lumian led the two patrol members into the primitive forest.
target: Post longum intervallum, Lumian duo vigilum membra in silvam primitivam duxit.

source: He informed them he’d seen Twanaku’s image in the chaotic zone ahead, seemingly composed of dream fragments.
target: Eis nuntiavit se imaginem Twanaku in zona chaotica prae se visam esse, quasi ex fragmentis somnii compositam.

source: He suspected there was a Desire Apostle mark present.
target: Suspicabatur ibi signum Apostoli Desiderii adesse.

source: Walking amongst the trees, giants in the night, Camus felt increasingly oppressed.
target: Inter arbores ambulans, ut gigantes in nocte, Camus se magis magisque opprimi sensit.

source: Before he could inquire about Twanaku’s image details, he suddenly heard a bowstring drawn taut.
target: Antequam de singularibus imaginis Twanaku quaereret, subito audivit chordam arcu strenue tensam.

source: Pa!
target: Pa!

source: An arrow, entwined with lightning, flew from afar.
target: Sagitta, fulmine implicata, ab longe volavit.

source: Camus dodged just in time as it grazed past, piercing into a rubber tree behind him amidst crackling lightning and charred bark.
target: Camus tempore sale evasit, dum sagitta paene praeter transiret, perforans in arborem caoutchouc post eum, inter fulmina crepitantia et corticem comburentem.

source: Lumian, Camus, and Rhea gazed into the distance, spotting a woman standing on a huge tree branch.
target: Lumian, Camus, et Rhea in longinquo conspexerunt, mulierem in ramo ingenti arboris stantem deprehendentes.

source: The woman wore dark leather armor, holding a hunting bow and arrows.
target: Mulier loricam ex pelle obscura gerebat, arcum venatorium et sagittas tenens.

source: Her brown hair was tied in two strands draped over her shoulders.
target: Capilli eius castanei in duas fascias alligati erant et super umeros recubebant.

source: Her light brown skin and wild, beautiful face couldn’t hide the coldness and hatred behind her eyes.
target: Cutis eius fuscopallida et facies fera ac pulchra non poterant celare frigorem et odium post oculos.

source: Rhea!
target: Rhea!

source: It was Rhea!
target: Erat Rhea!
